title: Wrong size shirt, no simple exchange option
text:
Ordered a 2xl shirt box, got a small shirt. Should be an easy fix...

No way to make an exchange, can only get a refund, and return everything in the box. Then Id have to reorder, which wouldnt work. I’d just be out the entire Smugglers Box.

I just want a shirt that would fit. Been a sub for years, but this might be the final straw...
label: neutral
